# lang

Language runtimes and version managers: Go, Ruby (chruby), Node (nvm), Python (pip) and uv.

---

## `go_get_verbose`

Fetch a Go module with verbose output. Thin wrapper kept for muscle memory; prefer `go install pkg@version` for installing binaries.

**Usage**

```sh
go_get_verbose <package>...
```

**Examples**

```sh
go_get_verbose github.com/spf13/cobra
```

**Requires** `go`

**OS** any &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/common/lang.sh:104`](../../modules/common/lang.sh#L104)

## `node_load_nvm`

Source nvm into the current shell. Called automatically the first time you run `nvm`; sourcing nvm.sh is the single most expensive thing a shell startup can do, so it is never done at load time.

**Usage**

```sh
node_load_nvm
```

**Examples**

```sh
node_load_nvm && nvm use --lts
```

**Requires** `nvm`

**OS** any &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/common/lang.sh:183`](../../modules/common/lang.sh#L183)

## `pip_generate_completion`

Regenerate the cached pip tab-completion script for the current shell and load it. This used to run on every shell start against a hardcoded /usr/bin/pip that does not exist on macOS; it is now explicit and only run when you ask for it.

**Usage**

```sh
pip_generate_completion
```

**Examples**

```sh
pip_generate_completion
```

**Requires** (`pip` or `pip3`)

**OS** any &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/common/lang.sh:257`](../../modules/common/lang.sh#L257)

---

## `pip_install_user`

Install packages into PYTHONUSERBASE (default ~/.pip) with verbose output, creating the directory if it does not exist yet. A leading "install" word is accepted and ignored, so `pip_install_user install foo` and `pip_install_user foo` behave the same.

**Usage**

```sh
pip_install_user <package>...
```

**Examples**

```sh
pip_install_user httpie
```

**Requires** (`pip` or `pip3`)

**OS** any &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/common/lang.sh:223`](../../modules/common/lang.sh#L223)

## `ruby_load_chruby`

Load chruby (and its auto-switching hook) into the current shell. Called automatically the first time you run `chruby`; run it by hand if you want directory-based .ruby-version switching to start working before then.

**Usage**

```sh
ruby_load_chruby
```

**Examples**

```sh
ruby_load_chruby && chruby 3.3.0
```

**Requires** `chruby`

**OS** any &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/common/lang.sh:121`](../../modules/common/lang.sh#L121)

---

## `ruby_remove_version`

Delete an installed ruby from RUBIES_HOME (default ~/.rubies). Prompts before removing anything.

> **⚠ DANGER** — Recursively deletes the whole ruby install directory.

**Usage**

```sh
ruby_remove_version <version-string>
```

**Examples**

```sh
ruby_remove_version ruby-3.1.4
```

**OS** any &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/common/lang.sh:153`](../../modules/common/lang.sh#L153)

---

## `uv_ensure_path`

Create ~/.local/bin if missing and make sure it is on PATH. uv, pipx and `cargo install` all install there.

**Usage**

```sh
uv_ensure_path
```

**Examples**

```sh
uv_ensure_path && uv tool install ruff
```

**OS** any &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/common/lang.sh:301`](../../modules/common/lang.sh#L301)
